claim: Try a finished audit with sample data in one click without writing real browser storage
where: landing primary action, demo banner, README
sandbox: fresh browser context; open /, delay its release lookup, click the sample action, and assert the seeded receipt with no localStorage or sessionStorage writes

claim: Reset demo restores the complete sample audit
sandbox: fresh browser context; open /demo, filter to Missing, reset, and inspect the All filter and all eight sample rows

claim: Starting for real discards sample data before folder selection
sandbox: fresh browser context with a cached valid license; leave /demo and inspect state and real receipt storage

claim: Media contents, names, hashes, and reports stay on this device
where: landing facts, privacy section, privacy page, README
sandbox: fresh browser context; monitor every request during the complete demo flow

claim: Matches supported media by SHA-256 content, even when a backup name or timestamp differs
where: landing receipt copy, audit page, README
sandbox: fresh browser context; export a receipt for the standard abc digest with a renamed equal-byte backup, then assert unequal same-name media is changed

claim: Lists every selected source file, including files this version cannot check
sandbox: fresh browser context; compare matched JPG and TIFF files plus an unsupported PSD source file, then assert its skipped row and no all-clear

claim: Supported media is compared by SHA-256, and unchecked files stay visible
where: Audit route metadata and audit screen
sandbox: fresh browser context; inspect the Audit metadata, compare a supported JPG with an unsupported PSD, and assert the skipped PSD remains in the receipt

claim: Reports complete and unpaired Live Photo files
sandbox: fresh browser context; use the HEIC/MOV sample pair and the missing HEIC sample

claim: Exports the complete receipt as CSV
sandbox: fresh browser context; download demo CSV and assert its header and one row per result

claim: Core scanning and CSV export work without an account or license
sandbox: fresh browser context with empty localStorage; open /audit

claim: The scanner never moves, edits, or deletes selected media
where: landing privacy section, audit screen, README
sandbox: fresh browser context; scan selected immutable File objects and confirm both remain in the receipt

claim: The installed web app and sample audit work offline after the first visit
sandbox: fresh browser context; load /demo, wait for service worker, go offline, and reload

claim: License checks send only the license token and no photo data
where: landing privacy section, privacy page, README
sandbox: fresh browser context with a test token; intercept the verification request and inspect its URL and empty body

claim: A valid Archive License saves local receipts and prints certificates
where: landing paid section, terms page, README
sandbox: fresh browser context with a cached valid test verdict; complete a fixture audit, save it, and invoke print

claim: Saved receipts do not include original media files
sandbox: fresh browser context with a cached valid test verdict; save a fixture audit and recursively inspect the stored receipt for files, blobs, bytes, data URLs, and object URLs

claim: Clear saved data removes the saved license and audit receipts from this browser
sandbox: fresh browser context with seeded license, verdict, and receipt data; use Clear saved data, reload, and inspect all three storage keys

claim: You can remove a saved local receipt
sandbox: fresh browser context with two saved receipt fixtures; remove one and reload history

claim: Reports missing, changed, duplicate, and extra files
sandbox: fresh browser context; filter the demo receipt once for each result class

claim: This version has no analytics, advertising, or tracking scripts
sandbox: fresh browser context; load the landing page and enter the sample audit while recording every request

claim: Desktop installers are available for the detected platform when a release is published
sandbox: fresh browser context; mock a published Linux release and assert the detected-platform download URL

claim: Published desktop releases include unsigned .dmg, .msi or .exe, .AppImage, and .deb installers
sandbox: published GitHub release API; assert the unsigned release notice and macOS, Windows, AppImage, and Debian assets

claim: Desktop releases include SHA256SUMS and latest.json
sandbox: published GitHub release API; assert both assets and verify a published asset checksum

claim: Desktop installers for v0.1.6 are unsigned
sandbox: fresh browser context; inspect the versioned installer status

claim: The Archive License saves up to 25 local receipts
sandbox: fresh browser context with 25 saved fixture receipts and a cached valid verdict; try to save one more

sandbox: public checkout request; follow the hosted Dodo checkout and assert product name, Total $19.00, and one-time unlock text

claim: The app rejects the same verified folder and never issues an all-clear when browser folder identity is unknown
sandbox: fresh browser context; use directory handles for one same-folder and two distinct DCIM folders, then exercise browser folder inputs for same and distinct selections

claim: The current file and count stay visible while scanning
sandbox: fresh browser context with delayed fixture streams; observe the current file and increasing count

claim: Source is always first
sandbox: fresh browser context at desktop and 390px; assert source precedes backup in DOM and visual flow

claim: One backup file can account for only one source original
sandbox: fresh browser context; compare two identical source files against one identical backup file

claim: The published desktop installer contains the source build named in its release manifest
sandbox: published latest GitHub release; extract its Debian package and compare embedded build.json with latest.json source_commit
